Map the project; write a CLAUDE.md the agents can trust.

Turn the idea into numbered, testable requirements + user stories.
Approve the requirements before design starts;
they are the contract all later work is tested on.
Decide how to build it — architecture, specs, decisions, threats.
architecture · component specs · ADRs (proposed) · threat model
Accept or revise the architecture decisions.
Trade-offs outlive the code, so you own them.
Plan, then implement + test — sized to the change tier — and review.
staged code + tests · PLAN-* (tier: trivial / standard / complex)
Prove it works — coverage, independent review, real build, regression.
re-runs suite (d2) · real build exits 0 (c2) · blockers fixed
Changelog, version bump, staged commit + tag + rollback plan.
CHANGELOG · version bump · staged commit + tag · rollback plan
Approve each publish when the guardrail asks.
It is outward-facing and hard to undo — you are the gate.
Run & learn — triage, monitor, compare health, feed the next cycle.
incident / dep / telemetry reports · post-release health
